# PROJECT_HANDOFF.md — Digital Wave Sales Intelligence

**Single authoritative handoff for a new AI/chat.** Generated by a full read-only audit (2026-08-16). Read this FIRST, then `FILE_MANIFEST.md`, `IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md`, `ROADMAP_CURRENT.md`, `AI_PRODUCT_SPEC.md`, `CRM_BOUNDARY.md`, `CURRENT_PHASE.md`.

> ⚠️ **START HERE, NOT WITH OLD DOCS.** `docs/` contains older PRDs/architecture that predate and contradict the current direction. If any old doc conflicts with this file, **this file wins** (unless the user overrides). See section W for the contradiction list.

## A. Product vision

**Digital Wave Sales Intelligence / Lead Discovery** is a standalone product that helps a salesperson:

1. Describe in **natural language** what kind of businesses/leads they want.
2. Have the system **understand the intent**.
3. **Discover** relevant businesses.
4. **Gather reliable** business information.
5. **Analyze digital presence** (website, socials, ratings).
6. **Identify what is missing** / problems / opportunities.
7. **Explain WHY** a business is a good lead (evidence-backed).
8. **Recommend** what Digital Wave should sell to that business.
9. **Prioritize / score** leads.
10. **Save as lead**, later sync to the **Digital Wave CRM**, later run **AI automation/workflows**.

The long arc (from old PRDs, still the intent): **discover → deduplicate → website audit → social analysis → AI analysis → lead scoring → CRM sync**. Implement in controlled phases, NOT all at once.

---

## B. Current user goal

The user is testing a **standalone Search/Lead product first** (the testing ground), and only later connects CRM / AI.

Hard user requirements:
- **SEARCH INTELLIGENCE FIRST** → **AI BUSINESS UNDERSTANDING** → **DIGITAL PRESENCE AUDIT** → **OPPORTUNITY DETECTION** → **LEAD QUALIFICATION** → **REAL LEAD TEST** → **ONLY THEN CRM INTEGRATION** → **ONLY THEN broader AI automation/workflows**.
- The user owns **Gemini Pro** and intends to use Gemini for AI later. Do **not** assume OpenAI; do not add an AI provider without explicit phase approval.
- Do **not** connect to the CRM yet. Do **not** build CRM UI here. Do **not** introduce n8n/AI automation yet.
- Do **not** reintroduce Clerk (fully removed; JWT is the only auth).
- Google real-data discovery is **not** considered complete yet. The mock provider is what the deployed preview actually runs (verified: deployed searches return `providerId: "mock"`).

## C. What has actually been implemented (verified)

Backend (NestJS 11, TypeScript, Prisma 7 + pg driver adapter, PostgreSQL/Supabase):
- **Phase 0 bootstrap**: NestJS app, global prefix `api/v1`, Helmet, CORS, throttling (default + auth limiters), global ValidationPipe (whitelist + forbidNonWhitelisted), global `AllExceptionsFilter`, `TransformInterceptor` (`{ data }` envelope), access-log interceptor, request-context middleware + AsyncLocalStorage (requestId), Swagger at `/docs`, `main.ts` + `serverless.ts` entrypoints, `createApp()` shared in `app.bootstrap.ts`.
- **Phase 1 JWT auth (self-managed, no Clerk)**: `POST /auth/register`, `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/refresh` (rotation, family, reuse detection), `POST /auth/logout` (revokes family), `GET /auth/me`. Access token TTL 900 s default; refresh 30 d. Argon2id password hashing. Refresh tokens stored SHA-256-hashed, one-time-use, `familyId`/`replacedByTokenId`. RBAC roles ADMIN/MEMBER/GUEST (register → GUEST). Custom `AuthGuard`/`RolesGuard` (global APP_GUARDs), `@Public()` opt-out, `@CurrentUser()`.
- **Search module**: `POST /api/v1/search` (query + governorate/category/minRating/verifiedOnly filters), `GET /api/v1/search/history`. Provider port + factory (`mock` always available; `google-places` when `SEARCH_PROVIDER=google-places` + `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY`). Normalization (text/phone/website/rating/verificationStatus). Persistence trail `ImportSource → SearchJob → SearchExecution → RawImport → SearchResult`, provider call **outside** the DB transaction, `RawImport`+`SearchResult` persist **atomically** in one `$transaction`. History bounded 1–100 (default 20). Arabic-aware mock provider (category keywords like `مطعم/عياد/أسنان`/…; unknown keyword → honest empty `[]`).
- **Leads module**: `POST /api/v1/leads` (idempotent per user+provider record), `GET /api/v1/leads`, `GET /api/v1/leads/:id`, `PATCH /api/v1/leads/:id` (status/notes), `DELETE /api/v1/leads/:id` (soft delete). Statuses NEW/REVIEWED/CONTACTED/QUALIFIED/DISQUALIFIED. Re-save after delete restores the lead (clears deletedAt, resets status/notes/savedAt). Soft-delete-aware uniqueness via SQL partial unique index `uq_leads_user_provider_active` (NOT `@@unique([userId, providerRecordId, deletedAt])`).
- **Health module**: `GET /api/v1/health` → `{ status: "ok", services: { database: "up" } }`.
- **Tests**: 184 backend tests pass (`npm test`, Node `node:test` + `tsx`). No DB/env needed (use-cases inject stubbed ports).

Frontend (React 19, Vite 8, TS 6, plain CSS, Arabic RTL):
- **Auth UI**: SignInPage (login + register, `auth-card`), `api/auth.ts`, `api/request.ts` (single-flight refresh, `ApiError`), `api/session.ts` (localStorage `dwsi_access_token`/`dwsi_refresh_token` + custom events).
- **Search UI**: SearchPanel (query + filters + مثال chips), SearchView (initial/skeleton/error/results/empty states), lead-card grid (`LeadCard`).
- **Result detail drawer** (`ResultDrawer`): full business info, save-as-lead CTA, status select, notes editor (4000 chars), delete.
- **Saved Leads view** (`SavedLeadsView`): status filter chips + lead cards.
- **Pipeline view** (`LeadsPipelineView`): 5-column kanban (جديد / تمت المراجعة / تم التواصل / مؤهل / غير مؤهل) + summary.
- **Recent searches** (`RecentSearchesView`): history with chips + re-run.
- **Settings** (`SettingsView`): account/plan/session + logout.
- **Workspace shell**: brand sidebar, the **five nav sections** البحث / عمليات البحث / النتائج المحفوظة / العملاء المحتملين / الإعدادات (all wired), avatar, logout.
- **Routing** (hand-rolled in `App.tsx`, no router lib): `/dashboard`, `/login`, `/`; after login → `/dashboard`; unauthenticated `/dashboard` → `/login?next=/dashboard`; logout → `/login`; Vercel SPA catch-all already serves `index.html` for `/dashboard` (refresh-safe).
- **Bug fixed**: `fetchMe()` previously returned the `{ data }` envelope instead of the profile → Settings crashed + sidebar showed "مستخدم غير معروف". Fixed in `api/auth.ts` (`return response.data`). DOM smoke tests (happy-dom) verify auth page, all 5 views, direct `/dashboard` mount, and logout redirect.

Deployment:

Build command runs backend build then `npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build`.

- **Production alias** (`digital-wave-sales-intelligence-pink.vercel.app` / `-digital-wave-team.vercel.app`) points to an OLD pre-MVP deployment (`9d5fuo7j3`) — **the current code is NOT on production**, and per user instruction it must stay that way.
- **Vercel Authentication (SSO) was disabled on the project** in a prior session (previously `all_except_custom_domains`). This plan cannot SSO-protect production ("not available on your plan"); production was already public. Previews are now public too. If production protection is ever needed, it requires a plan change.

## E. What was abandoned / rejected

- **Clerk**: evaluated → rejected → removed. Traces: migration `20260809233811_add_clerk_user_id` (added then dropped by `20260811225212_remove_clerk_user_id`), deleted files `clerk-identity.service.ts` / `clerk-identity.service.spec.ts` / `auth.guard.clerk.spec.ts`. **Never reintroduce.**
- **`db push`**: never use; migrations only (`npx prisma migrate dev` locally, `migrate deploy` in prod).

- **"CRM integration in MVP", "AI chat in MVP", "dashboard/automation in early MVP", "n8n"**: all explicitly **out of the current MVP scope**. Old docs that say otherwise are stale.
- **Google real-data "complete" claim**: do not make it (see D).

## F. Current architecture

- **Backend**: NestJS 11, hexagonal per module: `presentation → application → domain ← infrastructure` (ports & adapters). `domain/` and `application/` must not import `@nestjs/*` or `@prisma/client`. Controllers parse validated DTOs → call exactly one use-case → return (no business logic, no try/catch). Raw DB access only in `infrastructure/repositories/`, which return domain entities.
- **Database**: PostgreSQL (Supabase managed), Prisma 7 with **PrismaPg driver adapter** at runtime (`DIRECT_DATABASE_URL`) and Prisma CLI at build/migrate (`DATABASE_URL`, plain `postgresql://` scheme — never `prisma+postgres://` for Supabase).
- **Frontend**: React 19 + Vite 8 SPA, no router lib, no HTTP lib (native fetch), single `index.css`, Arabic RTL (`<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">`).
- **Auth**: stateless JWT (HS256), refresh rotation family, Argon2id, custom guards. **No Clerk, no OAuth, no Supabase Auth/RLS/Realtime** (Supabase = managed Postgres only).
- **Search**: provider port (`SearchProviderPort`) → factory selects `GooglePlacesProvider` or `MockSearchProvider`; normalization; persistence repositories behind ports; orchestration in `SearchCompaniesUseCase.search` (job+execution → provider OUTSIDE tx → atomic rawImport+results → mark completed; failure path marks both failed).
- **Vercel serverless**: `serverless.ts` lazily builds the app and default-exports the Express instance. Do not point Vercel at a `.ts` entry (decorator metadata is lost). Do not add a third bootstrap path.

## G. Current database schema

41 models in `prisma/schema.prisma` (migrations: 8, applied order listed in `FILE_MANIFEST`):

- **Auth/tenant**: `User` (email unique, passwordHash, status REGISTERED/ACTIVE/DISABLED), `RefreshToken` (tokenHash unique, familyId, replacedByTokenId, revoke/expire; hard-delete-able, no soft delete), `Workspace`, `Role`, `Permission`, `RoleAssignment`, `RolePermission`, `UserWorkspace`, lookup tables (`ContactMethodType`, `SocialPlatform`, `RoleLevel`, `PermissionGroup`).
- **CRM/entity models (FROZEN, currently unused by code)**: `Company`, `Branch`, `Person`, `Address`, `Website`, `SocialProfile`, `ContactMethod`, `Tag`, `Category`, `Employment` + 13 join tables (CompanyAddress, BranchAddress, PersonContactMethod, CompanyContactMethod, BranchContactMethod, CompanyWebsite, BranchWebsite, PersonSocialProfile, CompanySocialProfile, BranchSocialProfile, CompanyTag, PersonTag, CompanyCategory). All soft-deletable, UUID PKs, audit actors (`createdById`/`updatedById`/`deletedById`), `createdAt`/`updatedAt` timestamptz.
- **Search pipeline (implemented)**: `ImportSource`, `SearchJob`, `SearchExecution` (no soft delete), `RawImport` (append-only, nullable unique `contentHash`), `SearchResult` (read model, advisory `companyId` → `Company`, `@@unique([executionId, providerRecordId])`).
- **Leads (implemented)**: `Lead` (user-scoped snapshot of a discovered business; status enum NEW/REVIEWED/CONTACTED/QUALIFIED/DISQUALIFIED; notes ≤4000; soft delete; partial unique index `uq_leads_user_provider_active` on `(user_id, provider_record_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`).

Soft-delete-aware uniqueness = SQL partial unique indexes, registry has 10 entries in `docs/DATABASE_RULES.md`.

## H. Current API

Global prefix `api/v1` (set in bootstrap; controllers never add it). Success envelope `{ "data": ... }` (or `{ "data": [...], "meta": { count } }`); errors `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details? } }`.

| Method | Path | Auth | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/register` | public | email, password 8–128, displayName → user (GUEST) |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/login` | public | email/password → `{ accessToken, refreshToken, tokenType, expiresIn }` |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/refresh` | public | rotating refresh, family, reuse detection |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/logout` | Bearer | revokes whole refresh family |
| GET | `/api/v1/auth/me` | Bearer | profile; `@SkipThrottle` |
| GET | `/api/v1/health` | public | DB up/down |
| POST | `/api/v1/search` | Bearer | body `{ query, governorate?, category?, minRating?, verifiedOnly? }` → `{ data: SearchResultDto[], meta: { count } }` |
| GET | `/api/v1/search/history` | Bearer | `?limit=` 1–100 (default 20) → history items |
| POST | `/api/v1/leads` | Bearer | save lead (idempotent) → 201 |
| GET | `/api/v1/leads` | Bearer | list saved leads |
| GET | `/api/v1/leads/:id` | Bearer | 404 if not owned |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/leads/:id` | Bearer | `{ status?, notes? }` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/leads/:id` | Bearer | soft delete → `{ success: true }` |

Error codes: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `CONFLICT`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `NOT_ACCEPTABLE`, `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`, `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `INTERNAL_ERROR` (renaming is breaking). Prisma P2002/P2003 → 409, P2025 → 404.

Swagger: mounted at `/docs`.

## K. Current authentication

- Self-managed JWT (HS256). Access TTL 900 s default (`JWT_ACCESS_TTL`); refresh 30 d (`JWT_REFRESH_TTL`), rotated on every refresh, hashed (SHA-256) at rest, one-time-use with family + reuse detection (reuse revokes the whole family). Argon2id for passwords. RBAC: roles from `role_assignments` (`roles.kind = 'SYSTEM'`, join includes role deletedAt). Global `AuthGuard` + `RolesGuard`, `@Public()` opt-out. Login blocked unless user `ACTIVE`.
- Frontend keeps tokens in localStorage, single-flight refresh, auto-logout on refresh failure (`dwsi:session-expired`).

---

## L. Current search behavior

- `POST /api/v1/search` with `{ query, governorate?, category?, minRating?, verifiedOnly? }` (DTO whitelists these — `city` is NOT a valid field and is rejected).
- Provider selection (env): `SEARCH_PROVIDER=google-places` requires `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY`; default = google-places if key present else mock. **Deployed env uses mock.**
- Mock provider: 9 hardcoded Egyptian businesses; Arabic category keywords (`مطعم/مطاعم`→restaurant, `عياد`→clinic, `أسنان`→dental-clinic, `مركز/مستشفى`→medical-center, …); explicit category filter must intersect with query-derived category; otherwise query must text-match `companyName`/`address`/`area`; `verifiedOnly` requires `VERIFIED`; governorate exact match; `minRating` applied. Unknown keyword → `[]` (real empty state).
- Google provider: Places API (New) `searchText`, headers `X-Goog-Api-Key` + fieldmask, `includedType` map, timeout via `AbortSignal.timeout`, error mapping (timeout/429/5xx/etc. → 503 with `reason`).
- Each search persists: job (RUNNING→COMPLETED/FAILED), execution (attempt 1, trigger MANUAL, metrics), raw import (byte-faithful `payload` JSON), and `SearchResult` rows atomically; provider call outside the transaction.

## M. Current lead behavior

- Save (idempotent per `(userId, providerRecordId)`; active re-save no-op, soft-deleted row gets restored with status NEW, notes cleared, snapshot refreshed). List/get/patch/delete scoped to owner + active. Notes ≤4000. Status enum. Soft delete via `deletedAt`; partial unique index backstop. Frontend: save from search results or drawer; status select + notes editor; saved view with status filter; kanban pipeline; delete.

## U. AI/Gemini strategy

- Gemini is the **preferred** provider (owner holds Gemini Pro). Keep the provider architecture **abstract** (port/interface) so the provider is swappable; do not hard-code OpenAI or add an SDK without Phase E approval.
- AI must **never invent facts**: every conclusion requires evidence (grounded in persisted RawImport/SearchResult/website data). Design intent from `docs/sales-intelligence/07-ai-insights.md` (AI consumes only platform-produced data; never collects/verifies/merges/scores/executes; advisory, human-approved). Full spec in `AI_PRODUCT_SPEC.md`.

- **Not now.** No n8n, no workflow engine. In-house workflow/automation modules are the long-term design (`docs/database/shared/10-workflow.md`, `11-automation-job.md`, module boundaries in `docs/sales-intelligence/09-module-boundaries.md`). Phase I.
